summary.short: Spanish organic law (LO 3/2018) adapting Spanish law to Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and guaranteeing digital rights. Applies to automated and filing-based processing of personal data by controllers, processors and public bodies; sets data protection officer, transfer, enforcement and workplace-privacy rules. Does not regulate AI systems as such.
summary.long: Organic Law 3/2018 supplements and implements the GDPR in Spain and adds a set of digital rights. Title I sets its object and scope (Arts. 1-3) and covers processing of deceased persons' data. Title II sets data protection principles: accuracy (Art. 4), confidentiality (Art. 5), consent, with minors able to consent from age 14 (Arts. 6-7), legal bases for public-sector and legal-obligation processing (Art. 8), and limits on special-category and criminal-offence data (Arts. 9-10). Title III covers transparency and data-subject rights (Arts. 11-18). Title IV sets rules for specific processing: credit information systems, mercantile operations, video surveillance, advertising exclusion systems, internal whistleblowing systems and statistics (Arts. 19-27). Title V sets controller and processor duties, including risk-based measures (Art. 28), records (Art. 31), blocking (Art. 32), mandatory data protection officers for listed entities (Art. 34), and codes of conduct and certification (Arts. 38-39). Title VI governs international transfers (Arts. 40-43). Title VII establishes the Spanish Data Protection Agency and regional authorities (Arts. 44-62). Title VIII sets procedures (Arts. 63-69). Title IX classifies infringements as very serious, serious or minor with limitation periods, and sets sanction rules (Arts. 70-78). Title X sets digital rights, including minors' online protection, social network rectification, workplace device, video and geolocation monitoring, and search-engine and social-network erasure rights (Arts. 79-97). Penalty amounts are cross-referenced to GDPR Art. 83 rather than stated here.The text does not define or regulate AI systems as such.(Part 1 of 2; the final provisions on entry into force are not in this part.)
